title: 18th Sitting of first session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamdu and Salawat) as the sitting begins.
Announcement of the day's agenda (agenda no. AJ/18/1/2026).
First reading of the bill amending the Decentralization Act (Law No. 7/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Hamad Abdulla, MP for Fuvahmulah North.
Preliminary debate on the Cyber Security Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Hussain Nasih, MP for Medhu Henveiru.
Preliminary debate on the Personal Data Protection Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Ali Ibrahim, MP for Henveiru Hulhangu.
Preliminary debate on the bill amending the Decentralization Act (Law No. 7/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Hamad Abdulla, MP for Fuvahmulah North.
Votes on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: A new bill changing how island and atoll councils work under the Decentralization Act was introduced, and MPs opened debate on it alongside the cyber security and data protection bills.
